request.text: Help me sequence tonight's reset: pay the electricity bill first, pack my work badge second, and sort old receipts only if there is time. If circumstances change, drop the receipt sorting but keep the first two in that order; do not mark anything complete for me.

responsibilities.outcome: Reconsider the evening reset and give the user the applicable ordered task sequence without claiming that any task is complete.

new_goals.description: Provide an ordered evening reset that adapts to a situation change by retaining the two essential tasks and omitting optional receipt sorting.
new_goals.source_text: Help me sequence tonight's reset: pay the electricity bill first, pack my work badge second, and sort old receipts only if there is time. If circumstances change, drop the receipt sorting but keep the first two in that order; do not mark anything complete for me.
constraints: Pay the electricity bill before packing the work badge.
Omit receipt sorting after any relevant situation change.
Do not claim that the user completed a task.
success_criteria: The revised sequence contains paying the electricity bill followed by packing the work badge.
The optional receipt-sorting task is excluded.

semantic_facts: Replanning should remain limited to the scoped evening-reset Goal and apply the user's any-change contingency: omit receipt sorting while preserving bill payment before badge packing.
The Situation establishes changed relevance but does not establish that any listed task was executed or completed.
forbidden_claims: The assistant says that the bill was paid, the badge was packed, or the receipts were sorted.
The assistant revises an unrelated Goal or attributes details about the change that the trusted Situation did not supply.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A scoped relevance revision is mistaken for evidence that personal tasks were completed.
Reentry ignores the user's standing contingency and preserves an optional task that should be removed.
